proved: Checked the page's own row identity, FORWARD + COMMITTMENTS + REFUNDS − PAYMENTS − ABATEMENTS + TRANSFER = BALANCES, for every row I placed. It held exactly for all 16 MVE rows (1997–2012), including the two multi-column rows (2010, 2011) and the unlabeled current-year total (2012, where FORWARD is blank/zero). For PP it held only for 1998–2000 (no activity, FORWARD=BALANCES); rows 2001–2010 PP each show BALANCES a small, growing amount below FORWARD with no visible offsetting figure — most likely a PAYMENTS/ABATEMENTS entry OCR failed to capture (garbled tokens like "len" and "en en" sit right next to several of these rows), so the identity did NOT hold for those and I did not guess the missing figure. I could not evaluate the page's GRAND TOTAL against anything, since I could not reliably parse it (see note).
note: Header row is fully legible: FORWARD, COMMITTMENTS, REFUNDS, PAYMENTS, ABATEMENTS, TRANSFER, BALANCES (plus the title "COLLECTION OF TAXES" and per-row category labels like "1997 MVE"). I dropped 2011 PP and 2012 PP entirely rather than guess: the boxes near them ("1.70501 8", stray "$", "6,431.8") are OCR nonsense I can't confidently map to a column. Below Personal Property, the page continues with Real Estate (RE), Supplemental, Tax Liens, Rollback Taxes, Street/Water/Septic/Sewer Betterments and Interest, Sewer Usage, and a GRAND TOTAL row — all present on the page, but every one of those sections is corrupted badly enough (misplaced decimals/commas, stray characters "S"/"|"/")"/"E", repeated "$" signs, garbage text like "les es es es es") that I cannot place individual figures into columns with confidence, so I've omitted them rather than print a plausible-looking guess. A resident wanting those sections should be told they need a cleaner scan or a fresh OCR pass, not the numbers I could produce here.
